entities.name: Dorothea
entities.description: A geist of Innistrad, a skilled bloodline sorcerer slaughtered by Olivia Voldaren and now trapped in her wedding train.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who slaughtered countless humans and traps their souls in her wedding train.

events.summary: Dorothea is slaughtered by Olivia Voldaren and her soul trapped in Olivia's wedding train.
events.quote: Dorothea is among the countless humans mercilessly slaughtered by Olivia Voldaren over the years

relations.note: Olivia slaughtered Dorothea and trapped her soul.
